status: exploratory development after original pilot and leg follow-up results were seen
primary_selection_objective: mean inner-fold macro-F1 separately for back, arms, and legs, fixed observed class sets; not full-code accuracy
reference: unchanged paired-image expert consensus; back 1-4, arms 1-3, legs 2/3/4/5/7; load fixed at 1
data: same 181 purposively selected paired photographs from one worker in two recordings; illuminance pooled and not a predictor
features: unchanged original 74 generic pose or 1024 frozen MobileNetV3Small features per view; additional 66 leg features concatenated with generic pose for combined_leg_RF only
tie_break: first in predeclared order: view side, front, paired; family order as declared; first parameter then second; no outer-test tie-break
comparators: nine homogeneous model/view systems with per-component inner hyperparameter selection
modular_RF_flat: same back/arms as primary, combined-leg RF only
modular_RF_hierarchy: same back/arms, matched combined-leg hierarchical RF only
hierarchy: coarse static appearance families {2,3}, {4,5}, {7}; conditional 2-vs-3 or 4-vs-5 classifiers; no physical leg loading or walking dynamics measured; no oracle branch routing
hierarchy_matching: same features, views, parameter grid, imputation and RF tree count per node as matched flat RF; additional hierarchy nodes are a capacity difference and will be disclosed
outer_validation: five GroupKFold folds, recording-specific floor(video_second/60) groups; remove outer-train frames within <=10 seconds of outer-test frames in same recording
inner_validation: three GroupKFold folds within each purged outer training set, same block duration and <=10-second purge; imputer and scaler fit per inner training set only
sensitivity: repeat complete comparison with 30-second time blocks; preserve 60-second main result regardless of ranking
recording_transfer: both directions; model/view/parameter selection only within source recording; same-worker transfer, not clothing causality or new-worker validation
single_class_fallback: training-only DummyClassifier; log observed training classes; missing pose unresolved=0 and stays in denominator; embeddings remain available without pose
outputs: high-risk low predictions and unresolved counts
selectivity: existing leg-only selective experiment preserved separately; no uncalibrated new full-code confidence threshold or human-plus-machine accuracy claim
stacking: not included in this phase; limited independent support and rare classes do not justify expanding the search before testing the simpler modular baseline
freeze_for_external: refit all predeclared systems after identical inner selection using all existing observations, save models, feature code hashes and data hashes; primary remains modular_flat regardless of outer results; new-worker labels never used for selection
external_primary_endpoint: full-code exact agreement on paired-images-only consensus within observed component/load scope, denominator all eligible new observations including unresolved predictions; component macro-F1 and class recall also reported
external_scope: back 1-4, arms 1-3, legs 2/3/4/5/7, load 1; component evaluation can include valid in-scope components of an otherwise out-of-scope full code; video-assisted expert references reported separately
limitations: one worker, two recordings, irregular purposive sampling, repeated reuse for development; no population confidence interval, p-value, causal clothing claim, injury-risk probability or new-worker performance claim
